purpose: A physical self-consistent forward model using an auxiliary-density universal functional with exact energy recovery
input: Existing mean-field orbital densities and universal operators; no oracle density, correlated state or energy enters prediction
initialization: x=Q:D_meanfield-epsilon*v; each universal evaluation accepts only T,W,Q,N,occupation metadata and the auxiliary coordinate
self_consistency: x_next=q(Gamma_x)-epsilon*v; physical Gamma remains positive with exact fixed N,S
energy_recovery: F_epsilon(x)+v.x+epsilon*||v||^2/2 plus the fixed-number external constant and nuclear repulsion
stopping: Reduced physical-state gap, full response, self-consistency and lowest-state checks; no reference-error target
assessment: Only after prediction and consistency checks stop, compare with existing labels; generate no new correlated reference
limits: Auxiliary-density regularized KS formulation, not an unchanged conventional XC plugin
No general learned model or many-fragment closure
Not GMTKN55, CBS or speed evidence
